Row.Text: [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Prisoners of War[ENDCOLOR] is a new gameplay mechanic resulting from your combat victories. Successfully defeating an enemy unit now has a chance to leave you with prisoners of war, based on the advancement of your military Technologies. Prisoners of War must be dealt with through one of several actions, each rewarding a different Yield.
Can sacrifice [ICON_JFD_PRISONERS_WAR] Prisoners of War for [ICON_PEACE] Faith
Increases chance to capture [ICON_JFD_PRISONERS_WAR] Prisoners of War from combat (10%).
Gains [ICON_CULTURE] Culture from each enemy unit killed. Can always choose to sacrifice [ICON_JFD_PRISONERS_WAR] Prisoners of War for [ICON_PEACE] Faith and has +15% chance in capturing them.
Requires Honor. All units gain +15% [ICON_STRENGTH] combat strength when attacking cities. +20% chance to capture [ICON_JFD_PRISONERS_WAR] Prisoners of War.
